text:
Verified P1 with E2.

Analysis:
- E2 (0.619 ± 0.003 m): reliable, 585 frames, 12.3 cycles. Period 1.58836 ± 0.00075 s, cross-check 1.58858 s (agreement 0.23 sigma). T0 1.58521 ± 0.00075 s, amplitude 11.5 deg. Warning only: 2 outlier frames removed (>5 MAD). No problems.
- E1 (0.39 ± 0.01 m): reliable, 602 frames, 16.3 cycles. Period 1.24798 ± 0.00051 s, T0 1.24598 ± 0.00051 s. No problems or warnings.
- Damping E2: quadratic delta_AIC 0.0 weight 0.722 preferred over viscous delta_AIC 2.1 weight 0.253. Runner-up 2.1 behind (2-4 = weaker but still plausible), so only preferred, not proven. Coulomb delta 6.72, undamped delta 704.82 essentially no support.
- Damping E1: viscous delta 0.0 weight 0.862 preferred over coulomb delta 3.76 weight 0.132, quadratic delta 9.74. Runner-up 3.76 behind, so preferred, not proven. Undamped delta 900.78 no support.
- g fit from [E1, E2], no offset (2 distinct lengths): g = 9.7314 ± 0.0472 m/s2, chi2 0.55 with 1 dof.

Prediction test:
- P1 predicted for 0.6 m, tested with E2 at 0.619 m (mismatch 3.16667 %, within 20 %, blind = true). Frozen model re-evaluated at used length.
- T0 predicted 1.56972 ± 0.02049 s vs measured 1.58521 ± 0.00075 s, difference 0.98677 %, z = 0.75541, verdict confirmed.

Lab report:
Measured E1 and E2 periods and T0 as above, both reliable.
Damping winner differs by set: viscous preferred in E1, quadratic preferred in E2, both only preferred because runner-up within 4.
g = 9.7314 ± 0.0472 m/s2 from E1+E2.
P1 blind test with E2 confirmed (z 0.76).
Most useful next step: record ~0.30 m experiment to blind-test pending P2 and give 3 lengths to fit length offset.
